Perks › Uncommon

Light Fingers

Uncommon perk · Boneyard

Once per round, draw two bones and keep the one with fewer pips.

In-game card text

How it works

On a boneyard visit, you turn over one extra face-down bone: you pick two, both are revealed, and you keep the one with fewer pips. The other stays in the boneyard. If both have the same pip total, you choose.

  • It is used automatically on your first boneyard visit of each hand. Each copy gives one such visit per hand.
  • On a visit that Sovereign Draw, Dead Man's Draw or Greedy Draw already changes, Light Fingers sits out and keeps its use for a later visit.
  • It needs at least one spare bone in the boneyard beyond what you must take.

At a glance

RarityUncommon
TypeBoneyard
UsesOne use per hand for each copy you hold. Uses refill at the start of every hand.
How to get itUnlock it in the Perks compendium for 300 Bone Bucks once you own 5 Common perks.
